additional_info.subject: RE: FW: SI-D/SA 170003090 unable to reach router webpage 10.20.17.2 CRM:00314000193
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Today we finally managed to restore charger
170003116
Here follows a summary of the activities performed:
After last intervention, router XF4 was not accessible anymore, and replacement was required.
Router XF4 was replaced, taken from charger
170003086
in stock.
Password reset on router XF4, but charger was not reachable on SCB.
Found out also router XF3 was replaced form the charger in stock.
Reset the password for router Xf3. Thanks to R&D support, restore the access to webUI for both routers, which was blocked.
Updated both routers via CompanionTool to the latest Teltonika FW.
Rebooted the charger. Charger went finally online, and it was possible to configure the internet connection of router XF4 and establish the connection with the Backend.
The issue is now solved. Therefore, I will proceed to close this ticket
ID0437941.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
